newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian peaks claim 10th victim this week.
newsitem.headline: Italian peaks claim 10th victim this week.

text.p: A climber died in the Dolomites on Friday bringing the death toll on the mountains of northern Italy to 10 in the past week.
Police said 24-year-old Italian Stefano Boldrin fell 20 metres (65 ft) to his death from the approach to the summit of the Spiazzo mountain in northeast Italy.
His six climbing partners were unhurt.
On Tuesday, seven people fell to their deaths in two separate incidents on the Great Zebru mountain near the Swiss and Austrian borders.
Another climber perished on a nearby peak the same day and a 19-year old German was killed in an accident on Thursday.
